title: The pet's follow, fetch run and loot vacuum
oneLine: Your pet's follow / run-to-pile / come-back phases and the per-pile viaPet pickup ask.
topConcern: BroTown passes petFetchStep a hoisted, still-undefined `now`, so give-up, way-back, skip and look timers never fire.

title: The local player's death and respawn
oneLine: S._dying / _deathStart / respawnTimer: dead, respawn-invulnerable, alive; server and three legacy local paths.
topConcern: Three hand-copied respawn sequences survive beside respawn.js's 'ONE copy', skipping art release, npcs reset, Wheel trip, and still docking gold locally.

title: The renderer's life: init, retry, rebuild window, owed rebuild
oneLine: Pixi renderer init/fallback/backoff and the GL-loss rebuild via glEpoch, spread over window globals.
topConcern: The async init has no superseded check: an epoch bump mid-init can leave pixiRef on a detached canvas and leak a WebGL context.

title: The pre-game phase: checking, door, creator, into the world
oneLine: bootPhase checking/login/create/null plus showIntro, gating five effects and the two roads into joinTown.
topConcern: The creator road runs joinTown twice: PLAY calls it, then the auto-join effect fires because _autoJoined is only set inside it.

title: Quest banner queue and the level-up / achievement slots
oneLine: Quest banner preempt-or-queue (cap 3) with per-kind holds, held behind the loading gate.

title: Which windows are open: thirty booleans, three lists
oneLine: ~30 show* / panel flags, closeAllMenus, _desktopCloseAll and _anyPanelOpen feeding S._uiBusy and uiBusyBus.
topConcern: _anyPanelOpen omits clanInvite and every bus-driven window, so the chat feed and burst button stay up over them.

title: stats_update report-on-change with a last-signature stamp
oneLine: Client reports derived build (armor, skill tracks, grids, seeded T1) when its signature changes.
topConcern: The signature is stamped before a send the shim silently drops while reconnecting, so a change made then is lost on rejoin.

title: The local rpg cache (bt_rpg): seed, migrate, overwrite
oneLine: bt_rpg loaded and shape-guess migrated into S.rpg before the worker's player_state replaces it.
topConcern: The cache carries no shape version; migrations infer old shapes from field presence. The btRpc load road is dead code.

title: May I move this frame: walk-freeze flags and their copies
oneLine: Veils, loading, race line, sled, stun, loot freeze and death that zero the stick or the walk.
topConcern: Sprint's 'moving' omits _avatarArtHold and raceHeld, so on Lil Bro's start line predicted stamina drains while the worker bills nothing.

title: The two touch discs: painted / pressable / lit / hot / ghost
oneLine: Per-frame resolver for the right contextual disc and left stick visibility, press-ability and face.

title: A lit campfire: strike, fire, keep-alive, burn out
oneLine: Client-local firemaking and campfire lifecycle, pushed alive while cooking, cleared on zone change.

title: The harvest in progress (S._extraction) tick and cancels
oneLine: Extraction waiting to ready via worker hits or timer; cancelled by stick, reach, node loss or zone change.
topConcern: A locked try waits on Infinity until its plan lands; a lost gather_hits leaves WAIT on the disc until you move.

title: A townsperson's frame: racing, companion, day-walk or wander
oneLine: Per-NPC wander/companion/chat timers and the quest badge derived each frame from quest state.

title: The walk-up dialogue latch (?npcprox only)
oneLine: Proximity opener's {npc, ready} latch with open/clear hysteresis, dormant since tap-only talking.

title: The clan war's local clock
oneLine: S._activeClanWar active, ended, cleared; ended both by the phone's timer and the worker's clan_war_end.
topConcern: With caps.clans the local clock still shows WAR WON and a pay line and can pre-empt or swallow the worker's verdict.

title: GameApp's sound keeper: unlock, away, re-arm on tap
oneLine: Visibility, pageshow, focus and a late heartbeat arm BT_AUDIO's session reclaim and kick for the next gesture.

title: Small dead or dormant machines in this half
oneLine: Tutorial steps, farm-bed sleep, worn-armour toggle, hostile poll, NFT lookup, town music interval.
topConcern: Dormant client-authoritative writes (full HP, buffs, free armour art) wake if tile 15 or InventoryPanel returns.

title: Per-frame action ticks: roll, lunge, whirlwind, gust, climb, jump latch
oneLine: Nullable in-progress move records ended by arrival, window, death or zone change.

title: Canvas sizing: resize, watchdog and iOS page lock
oneLine: Edge-triggered resize plus a level-triggered watchdog sharing bandFootprint, standing down while typing.

title: A tab left open across a deploy (staleBuild)
oneLine: buildWatch mismatch: reload on a pre-game screen, else the update banner.

title: The idle clock and the AWAY flag
oneLine: S._lastInputAt drives the page's idle logout and the aw flag the worker trusts for its sweep.

title: Who this page plays as: S.myId worked out at mount
oneLine: Guest, adopted, minted or corrected identity; every key change otherwise reloads.
topConcern: _takeKeyId corrects S.myId in place while other key changes reload; earlier readers can disagree (no live breakage found).

title: React mirrors of the loop's 'what is near me'
oneLine: Nearest node/door/hall/farm buttons pushed to React on change; one room picture warmed.

title: Device-local lists and counters (bt_stats, bt_clan, friends)
oneLine: Per-device stats, clan cache and social lists restored at mount with no version.
topConcern: visitedBuildings returns as an Array (no .size); bt_clan is not a per-character cache key, so a switch shows the old clan until join.

title: Client-local gather node respawn
oneLine: Harvested nodes revive on respawnAt only while the worker is not authoritative for nodes.

title: Character creator's preview states and randomize flair
oneLine: Camera framing, facing, drag-rotate and a 3-step randomize interval over store-mirror trait pairs.

title: The chat composer and the log's change bump
oneLine: chatOpen, input value with a ref mirror, send and refocus; one wrapper bumps the feed's bus.

title: The slime proximity hum's looping source
oneLine: Buffer load, one looping source and a gain following the nearest slime within 250 px.
topConcern: After BT_AUDIO rebuilds its AudioContext the slot keeps the closed context's nodes and never recreates them: slimes silent until reload.
